review_evidence: README states the repository formalizes possibly infinite finite-degree trees and a special case of Koenig's lemma in Lean.
Inspected PossiblyInfiniteTree.lean: it defines the tree structure and core operations with extensionality and membership theorems.
Inspected FiniteDegreeTree/KoenigsLemma.lean: it proves finiteness/branch results and defines the infinite-branch generator used by the theorem.
summary: Retain all seven primary Possibly-Infinite-Trees modules; they are the formal data structures and Koenig-lemma development.
